name: howto
title: The Instant Pot Duo in five minutes
sub: Six steps from box to first meal, from the Instant Pot Duo v5 manual (Aug 2025)
footer: Source: Instant Pot Duo v5 user manual, Aug 2025; read your own model's manual.

items.head: Run the test
items.body: Steam with water, no food, 5 minutes; discard the water.

items.head: Seat the ring
items.body: Press down, no puckering; replace every 12–18 months.

items.head: Add liquid
items.body: 1½ cups minimum for 6 qt; stay below PC MAX.

items.head: Lock and seal
items.body: Arrow to lock, switch to Seal; up to 30 min to pressure.

items.head: Pick a release
items.body: Natural for stews and beans, quick for vegetables.

items.head: Open with care
items.body: Wait for the float valve; hands away from steam.
